CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  NOTICE OF REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Committee Meeting will be
held on Wednesday August 17, 2022, commencing at 7:00 P.M. at Alhambra City Hall 111 South First Street, Alhambra,
California via video conference.

  CORONAVIRUS (COVID-19) ADVISORY NOTICE

Consistent with AB 361, the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting will not be physically open to the public,
although the public may participate by video conference or teleconference and all Commission members will
participate via video conference or teleconference rather than attend in person.

Watch and listen to the meeting via Zoom Webinar:

Zoom Webinar direct link:

https://us06web.zoom.us/j/89536857194?pwd=Q1NaY0VnUjk4anl1SStQSnVzdnpvQT09
Webinar ID: 895 3685 7194 Passcode: 489457

Or by telephone by dialing (877 853 5257 US Toll-free, 888 475 4499 US Toll-free, 833 548 0276 US Toll-free, 833 548 0282
US Toll-free entering Webinar ID: 895 3685 7194 and Passcode: 489457. Please Note: All members of the public calling or
logging into the meeting will be muted so that the meeting can proceed.

Addressing the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission:

Via Zoom or Telephone: “Raise your hand” - Members of the public may speak by using the “Raise Hand” function during
the public comments portion, if on Zoom or telephone. Staff will unmute speakers participating via Zoom or telephone and
announce your name when it is your time to speak.

Remarks are limited to 5 minutes; however, the presiding officer may either extend or reduce the maximum time to such period
of time as the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission may determine.

For those wishing to speak on an agenda item, please e-mail Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org prior to
the meeting with the item number you wish to speak on and your name. You should then join into the meeting 10 minutes
prior to its start time. Ms. Rivadeneyra will announce to you when it is your time to speak. You will have five minutes to
speak, unless that time is adjusted by the President.

As an alternative you can e-mail your comments by sending them to kelsey@cityofalhambra.org no later than 5:00 P.M.
on Wednesday August 17,, 2022 to ensure that it will be printed prior to the beginning of the meeting. Comments will then
be read into the record, with a maximum allowance of 5 minutes per individual comment, subject to the President’s
discretion. If a comment is received after 5:00 P.M. but before the conclusion of the meeting based on its time stamp, the
comment will still be included as a part of the record of the meeting but will not be read into the record.

Any member of the public who needs accommodations or who needs their comments translated should e-mail or call
Kelsey Rivadeneyra at kelsey@cityofalhambra.org or (626) 570-5044 who will use their best efforts to provide reasonable
accommodations to provide as much accessibility as possible while also maintaining public safety. Given the challenges of
video conference meetings, all participants are encouraged to e-mail their comments prior to the beginning of the meeting.
  KELSEY RIVADENEYRA

  CLERICAL ASSISTANT II

  APPROVE

  MINUTES
  ALHAMBRA CITY ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS COMMISSION
  Wednesday, June 15, 2022
  7:00 P.M.

The regular meeting of the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission was called to order at
7:05 P.M. on Wednesday, June 15, 2022, at Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First Street
Alhambra, via Video Conference Zoom.

ROLL CALL
Committee Members Present: President Canseco-Chan, Vice President Saunders, Commission
Member Arambula and Commission Member Jimenez.
Committee Members Absent: Commission Member Hermano.
Also attending: Director Macias, Deputy Director Brie Houghton, Recreation Supervisor
Amanda Leonard and Clerical Assistant II Kelsey Rivadeneyra.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES OF THE APRIL 20, 2022 REGULAR C.A.C.E. MEETING
AND MINUTES OF THE MAY 24, 2022 SPECIAL MEETING
With a motion from Vice President Saunders and a second by Commission Member Jimenez, the
minutes from the April 20, 2022 regular meeting and May 24, 2022 special meeting were
approved.

ALHAMBRA ART ALLEY PROJECT
No update from the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission.

STAFF REPORT
Recreation Supervisor Amanda Leonard shared a short overview of the City of Alhambra
Memorial Day event held at Alhambra Park on May 30, 2022.

PUBLIC COMMUNICATION
None.

COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION
Vice President Saunders put forth a motion for the City Arts and Cultural Events Commission to
return with a type of art and possible location for the District Projects at the next City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission meeting after speaking with their Council Member; Commission
Member Jimenez seconded the motion.

Commission Member Arambula requested creation of a database of previous artists that have
collaborated with the City of Alhambra for the Commission and public’s reference. Clerical
 Assistant II Rivadeneyra will compile a list of previous artists and bring to the next City Arts and
Cultural Events Commission meeting.

Commission Member Jimenez put forth a motion for the City Arts and Cultural Events
Commission to review the RFP and Alhambra Art survey results then provide feedback or
propose revisions at the next City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting. A second was
provided by Vice President Saunders.

The City Arts and Cultural Events Commission discussed the possibility of adding a statement to
the RFP that although it is open to all artists, artists with a connection to Alhambra will be given
special consideration and preference.

ADJOURNMENT
With a motion by Commission Member Arambula and seconded by Vice President Saunders, the
June 15, 2022 City Arts and Cultural Events Commission meeting was adjourned at 7:52 P.M.
